prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the supplied user's new chibi dragon-girl walking frame. Create ONE clean neutral standing master sprite of THIS SAME NEW CHIBI DESIGN for mAIverse. Preserve this image's face, white long hair, lavender eyes, white/lavender dress, rosette knot jewelry, small shoes, white scaled curved tail and dragon wings, same detailed anime chibi rendering and big head/small body. Do not revert to another earlier illustration. Change only the posture into a relaxed neutral standing pose, facing RIGHT in three-quarter/profile view, both feet side by side on the same ground level, elbows relaxed and two small anatomically sound closed hands, no raised finger gestures. Correct the horn anatomy: EXACTLY TWO white dragon horns total, one on either side; remove the extra small central cone-shaped horn-like spike, retain the curved single hair ahoge. Make wings clearly bat-like lavender membrane with white borders, folded compactly behind shoulders, not extra feather hair. One white scaled tail, two arms, two legs only. Full body including horn tips/shoes/tail entirely visible. Fixed 512x640 canvas or same 4:5 aspect; centered with 35px side and top safe padding and shoe baseline near y590. Transparent background actual alpha, preserve all opaque white hair/clothing. No text, labels, ground shadow or checkerboard. This is the identity and scale reference for subsequent real locomotion and roll frames.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet. Input image 1 is the LOCKED CHARACTER MASTER; input image 2 is the user's prior 4-frame walking style reference. Create a genuinely animated, anatomically coherent WALK-RIGHT CYCLE of the exact SAME little white/lavender dragon girl. Output ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, EXACTLY 4 columns by 3 rows = 12 full-body sequential sprites, read left to right then next row. Landscape-near-square atlas 2048x1920, each equal cell 512x640. No text, numbers, separators, cell borders, shadows or background. Every sprite fits INSIDE its own cell with at least 24px safe padding; no overlap between cells. Identical character head/body proportions, hair silhouette, knot jewelry and white/lavender clothing in EVERY frame. EXACTLY TWO WHITE HORNS, two ears, two arms with compact correct closed hands, two legs, one white scaled tail, folded lavender membrane wings. No third horn, no extra limbs. Gaze and calm mouth remain stable, do not insert a laughing or winking expression mid-cycle. Camera stays fixed facing right three-quarter side, entire horn tips, feet, wing and tail visible. The body walks IN PLACE: same root center and ground baseline in each cell, with natural small vertical bob, not a different rescaled drawing. Draw 12 DISTINCT locomotion phases with obvious alternating feet: 1 near LEFT leg reaches forward/heel contact, far RIGHT leg extended back; 2 left weight acceptance/knee bends; 3 right foot lifts behind; 4 right knee passes left support leg; 5 right knee swings forward raised; 6 right heel approaches ground; 7 FAR RIGHT leg now forward heel contact while NEAR LEFT leg back (OPPOSITE of frame1); 8 right weight acceptance/knee bends; 9 left foot lifts behind; 10 left knee passes right support leg; 11 left knee swings forward raised; 12 left heel approaches ground, naturally connecting back to1. BOTH legs must actually swap front/back roles, not 12 variants of the same split-legged pose. Arms counter-swing, hair, hem and tail follow with restrained delayed motion while stable clothing patterns don't morph. Exaggerate leg lift and weight transfer just enough to read at 72px, keep cute and balanced. Never rotate or slide the whole standing master instead of drawing proper poses. True alpha transparency, white details inside the character opaque.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create a GAME ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET based on the exact new chibi dragon girl in this master reference, no redesign. EXACTLY 8 sprites in a rigid 4 column x 2 row grid, 2048x1280 target, equal 512x640 cells. Each cell has ONE complete full-body character, at least 45px transparent padding all sides, no clipping, no overlap, no text or grid lines. Real transparent alpha background, all white hair and clothing opaque. Show one cute SIDEWAYS SOMERSAULT / ROLL then stand back up, in place on a common ground line. Read row-major: 1=neutral standing exactly like reference; 2=deep crouch, knees bend, arms tuck and wings fold; 3=tucked compact curled pose leaning onto RIGHT side, hands holding knees, white tail curling protectively; 4=upside-down curled ball midway through roll, show small shoes above head, dress modestly wrapped and tail curled, head/hair/body anatomically rotate together; 5=curled ball on opposite side of rotation, preparing to uncurl; 6=uncurl into low crouch, hands lowering, feet returning to ground; 7=rise up straightening knees with a little bounce; 8=the original neutral standing pose again. Full action must be visibly different in each key frame; draw real bent knees, tucked arms and body curl, do NOT rotate a rigid straight standing sprite. Maintain EXACTLY TWO white horns (no third central cone), same white long hair, purple eyes, knot ornament, white/lavender frilly dress, short chibi body, white scaled single tail and lavender bat-membrane folded wings. Same face identity and character scale across cells; curled poses are physically shorter without scaling the head smaller. Strong readable action at tiny 72px size, clean stable costume pattern. Expression calm/playful, no dramatic expression changes. Soft anime illustration matching reference. No motion trails, sparkles, ground shadows, props, numbers, captions or checkerboard. Give generous safety margin above horns, below shoes, and around curled poses.

Use case: identity-preserve. Create a transparent animation sprite sheet of exactly the SAME chibi white/lavender dragon girl as the supplied master. Keep the same right-facing three-quarter neutral pose, same feet side by side, fixed ground and root anchor, head size exactly constant across all 8 cells. 1 neutral eyes open, 2 gentle inhale body rises subtly, 3 inhale peak tiny shoulders rise, 4 relax body settles, 5 eyelids half close, 6 blink eyes closed with mouth still calm, 7 eyes half open, 8 original neutral. Tail tip and hair ends have a subtle 1-phase delayed sway; wings move very slightly with breathing. Low-amplitude stable breath, no walking, no large floating, no hand gestures, no changing facial proportions, no laugh. Exactly two white horns, two small anatomically correct closed hands, same white/lavender dress and knot ornaments, one white scaled tail and folded lavender membrane bat wings. Do not morph clothing patterns or add spikes/limbs. Every character ENTIRELY inside its cell, horn tips and shoes and tail uncut, at least 10% cell padding. Intended target 2048x1280, equal 512x640 cells, row-major. Transparent alpha background; white clothing and hair remain opaque. No numbers, lettering, grid marks, shadows, sparkles or props.

Use case: identity-preserve. Character animation production task. Reference is the approved new white/lavender chibi dragon girl. Draw a clean WALK CYCLE as eight separate sequential poses on ONE transparent sheet: precisely 4 columns x 2 rows, READ LEFT TO RIGHT then next row. Keep the exact identity, face, two white horns, lavender eyes, long white hair, white/lavender dress, bat membrane wings, knot jewelry and white scaled tail. Calm face and correctly formed small closed hands, two legs only. ALL poses look right. Show a TRUE ALTERNATING LEGGED gait in place with large readable leg movement, not eight images of the same stride. Frame 1 NEAR leg forward, FAR leg back, both touching ground. Frame 2 weight on NEAR leg, knees flex and head slightly lowered. Frame 3 NEAR leg supports body upright while FAR knee lifts forward passing it. Frame 4 FAR leg swings forward preparing heel contact, NEAR heel lifts behind. Frame 5 FAR leg forward and NEAR leg BACK, opposite leg roles to frame1; show the FAR shoe/leg in slightly deeper lavender shadow to distinguish it. Frame6 weight on FAR leg, knees flex. Frame7 FAR leg supports body while NEAR knee lifts forward, clear bent-knee passing pose. Frame8 NEAR leg swings forward preparing next heel contact, FAR heel lifts back; connects to1. Arms swing opposite the stepping legs, tail and hair lag slightly, costume patterns remain stable. Fixed camera, fixed head size, feet ground height consistent across cells, natural modest bob, do not rescale each pose. CRITICAL LAYOUT: each full-body sprite occupies only the CENTER 70 percent of its own cell; leave the outer 15 percent of each cell on ALL sides COMPLETELY EMPTY TRANSPARENT. This includes the curved ahoge, horn tips and feet: absolutely NO part may touch the image edge or adjacent cell. Large transparent gutters between sprites, generous transparent OUTER BORDER. No text, numbering, lines, scenery, shadows or effects. Total canvas approximately 2048x1280 with equal cells. True alpha transparency. Preserve the white character interiors opaque. Strong full gait, cute and balanced.
